from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityAdmission(BaseModel):
    """One university's admission statistics from its CDS report for first-time, first-year students."""
    university: str | None = Field(description="The university name as identified in the document")
    admission_count: int | None = Field(description="Total number of degree-seeking first-time, first-year students admitted")
    men_admitted: int | None = Field(description="Number of men admitted, if available")
    women_admitted: int | None = Field(description="Number of women admitted, if available")
    term: str | None = Field(description="The admission term, e.g., Fall 2021")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    university_admissions: list[UniversityAdmission]
